name: AD service status board
description: Color-configured snapshot variant of AD service status. Latest observed state per DC/service in the selected range; absent services are not inferred to be running.
kql:
ConfigurationData
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where ConfigDataType == 'WindowsServices'
| where SvcDisplayName in ('Active Directory Domain Services', 'Kerberos Key Distribution Center', 'DNS Server', 'Intersite Messaging', 'Netlogon', 'DFS Replication', 'Azure Advanced Threat Protection Sensor', 'Snare')
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, SvcDisplayName
| project Computer, SvcDisplayName, SvcState, SvcState__Status = SvcState, LastObservation = TimeGenerated
| order by Computer asc, SvcDisplayName asc
